# FBX source fixtures

These unmodified files come from `https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx/tree/v0.23.1/data` under the MIT alternative in the accompanying LICENSE. `provenance.json` records exact SHA-256 hashes. The importer uses the separately pinned Rust crate 0.11.5 with bundled C0.23.1; no fixture is generated by an Autodesk SDK dependency.

The cube/parent/instance files exercise static geometry, hierarchy, units and axes; the seven-material Suzanne exercises material partition bindings. The textured, animated, skinned and blend-shape files are explicit unsupported-input controls. Tests derive small ASCII variants from the real Maya cube to exercise negative transforms, corrupt bytes/indices, invalid units, and embedded/project-relative image records. Those derivatives are written only into temporary test directories; the upstream fixtures remain byte-identical.

Numerical test PNGs encode coordinates and are not game art or visual acceptance. Claude owns rendered review separately. No complete DCC material/animation/skinning compatibility is claimed.
